review:
Dragon Queen Megaways is a fantasy battle slot on Megaways reels. Crown wilds carry a 2x multiplier, boosting any win they're part of.

Three or more scatters trigger the bonus, where a Wheel of Fortune decides both the number of free spins (5 to 15) and a single multiplier from 2x to 25x that applies to every win in the round. That opening spin has a big influence on how valuable the bonus will be. Chance x2 and a bonus buy are available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 6,000x maximum and a 96.75% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 136 spins. It's built on the same engine as Lady Wolf Moon Megaways.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 136 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
